title: Natural Indicators
guideExplore: Pick an indicator and a substance to drip in, then press Start drip and watch the beaker change color.
guideAcidTest: Acid test: an acid is dripped in automatically — watch cabbage juice turn pink/red or turmeric stay yellow.
guideBaseTest: Base test: a base is dripped in automatically — watch cabbage juice turn blue/green or turmeric turn red-brown.
conditionsHint: Sim speed changes how quickly the drip mixes in and the beaker color settles.
learnMore: Natural indicators are dyes from plants that change color depending on whether a substance is acidic, neutral, or basic (alkaline). Cabbage juice and turmeric are two easy kitchen indicators.
